capability: Parts held by few neighbours are the floppy ones
title: Floppy parts have fewer joins.

hook.picture: Close on the whale propping a pod on one end of a still, knotted line. The end flops and the pod slides off.
hook.words: It looks solid in the picture.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: It looks solid in the picture. I can't tell what wobbles.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: student looking at a molecule diagram

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three more guesses, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. Each propped pod slides off.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: A still picture hides what wobbles.

stakes.body: Guessing which part is firm wastes experiments and leads to building on the floppy end.

solution_hint: Count how many neighbours hold each part.

metaphor.body: Count the joins holding each part of the chain. Parts with many joins barely move; parts with few swing wide. A warm-to-cool wash along the line becomes a wobble map.

steps.picture: Dashed joins appear between each part and the parts it touches. The dense core has many; the loose tail has two.
steps.words: Count the neighbours holding each part.
steps.sound: One knock per join, the core dense, the tail sparse.

steps.picture: The whale taps the line. Parts with few joins swing wide (rust halo); parts with many barely move (teal).
steps.words: Each touching pair is a seam.
steps.sound: Firm knocks under the core, loose boings at the tail.

steps.picture: Push-in on the loose tail. Two joins, a big swing, and a ring measures it.
A warm-to-cool wash spreads along the line: wide swing is warm, still is cool. The wobble map.
steps.words: Few seams means a floppy part.
steps.sound: A rising scale settles on the firm knock.

real_case.claim: Sheaf-Laplacian flexibility was compared with X-ray B-factors on three proteins: 1UBQ r=0.64, 1PGB r=0.50, 1CRN r=0.39 (r=0.69 at 7 A cutoff).

honest_limit.picture: On the third knot, a segment held by many joins (cool in the count) glows warm in the X-ray wash. The count said still; it moved.
honest_limit.words: Some parts wobble anyway. The count misses them.

not_this.body: A good guess, not a measurement.

ending_pattern.body: A warm-to-cool wash appears over the same still knot, and the whale props its pods on the cool end, where they stay.
ending_pattern.callback: The end that flopped in bar 2 is now shown warm, and the pod sits on the cool end instead, in the same framing.

end_belief.body: Check what holds a part before trusting it.

beats.picture: The whale adds a second pod on the firm end. Both stay. Spark.
The knot with its wobble wash, the whale breathing.

score_self.reason: It's a fresh, learner-friendly idea: count what holds a part. The limit is honest because the source correlations are only moderate. The weak spot is that 'roughly' on screen could undersell a 0.64.
